final: SELECT per_site_data.entrystat, AVG(per_site_data.avg_ram) as avg_of_site_averages_ram, AVG(per_site_data.avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) as avg_of_site_averages_ratio FROM (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) as avg_ram, AVG(CASE WHEN sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu > 0 AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(sp.procgpu AS FLOAT) / sp.proccpu ELSE NULL END) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) as per_site_data GROUP BY per_site_data.entrystat ORDER BY per_site_data.entrystat
